commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
90+6' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Leganes.

90+6' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle after Jose Copete (Mallorca) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Leganes, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

90+2' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
90+1' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle after Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
88' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
86' Jose Copete (Mallorca) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Ruiz signals. Leganes are awarded the free kick.
85' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Pablo Maffeo is replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johan Mojica trots off the pitch and is replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
83' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Ruiz signals a foul. Mallorca have a free kick.

81' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Marc Domenech (Mallorca), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
80' A substitution has been made. Yvan Neyou is replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
79' The ball is out of play. Leganes will have a chance to score from a corner.

79' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom left corner, but Dominik Greif keeps it out. Leganes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yvan Neyou (Leganes) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Diego Garcia will be replaced by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes).
76' A substitution has been made. Seydouba Cisse goes off and Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) comes on.
75' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
73' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jose Copete (Mallorca) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Leganes.
72' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
71' Mallorca force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' The attendance for today's match is 17404.
65' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and flies wide of the target.
65' The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
64' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) replacing Daniel Rodriguez.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marc Domenech (Mallorca) will replace Abdon Prats.

62' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
61' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' It looked like the long-range shot by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
59' A free kick to Leganes.
59' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
54' Yan Diomande (Leganes) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
54' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
51' Leganes couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Dominik Greif (Mallorca) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
50' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Leganes get a free kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Leganes will take a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Leganes.
44' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
43' Dominik Greif leaps like a salmon to deny Seydouba Cisse (Leganes), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.

42' Renato Tapia (Leganes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. There is a free kick near the sideline to Mallorca.
39' A shot from the edge of the box by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
37' Referee Alejandro Ruiz has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and brandishes a yellow card at him!
35' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
34' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' One of the Mallorca players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Leganes have a free kick.
25' The free kick from long range, taken by Leganes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' A player from Mallorca takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Abdon Prats (Mallorca) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
22' Renato Tapia (Leganes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
21' Yan Diomande (Leganes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the left post.
18' Leganes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
16' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game. One of the players from Mallorca won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
15' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner with a short pass.
14' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
13' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' A clumsy foul by Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
6' A player from Leganes brings down an opponent and commits a foul.

5' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
4' Leganes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leganes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Poor challenge! Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is penalised for tripping and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Leganes earn a free kick.
